provenance_note: The isolated gateway served the Create Folders From Project app built into the Kiro Crew checkout (src/kiro_crew/apps/builtins/project_scaffolder, website/src/apps/project-scaffolder), because a gateway that still ships the built-in cannot install a second app under the same name. This repository is the externally packaged copy of that page, ported with the same markup, strings and requests; PORTING.md lists where the two differ, and none of the differences is on screen in these pictures.
data: fictional: a made-up project folder written by capture/demo_tree.py (see data_notes); the folders on screen were created by the page's own Create button
data_notes: The app scans a directory on disk and has no API that writes one, so capture/demo_tree.py wrote a made-up workspace (an allotment-planner project for a community garden, with two small git repositories inside it) under the system temp directory, and the gateway ran with HOME pointing at the made-up home folder beside it.
The sidebar folders in the results picture were created by pressing the page's own Create sidebar folders button.
